note_en: 主要用于 means "used mainly for," and the purpose follows directly with no extra word: 主要用于后勤补给和护航支援 "used mainly for logistics resupply and escort support." Where English needs a passive ("is used") plus "for," Chinese 用于 does both jobs in two characters, so it is a staple of formal descriptions of what buildings, facilities and equipment are for.
